recipeSha256: Root independently supplies exact committed RECIPE.json raw SHA256
finalSealSha256: Root independently supplies exact committed FINAL-SEAL.json raw SHA256
componentReviews: One source-bound different-reviewer reference for each RECIPE.requiredReviews item: component,sourceSeal,commit,receiptSha256,disposition=PRELAUNCH_COMPONENT_REVIEW_COMPLETE. Root authenticates these referenced receipts before routing; regex format alone is not independent review.
outputRoot: /private/tmp/git-m1b-fca-independent- followed by 8..80 alphanumeric/hyphen characters; MUST NOT already exist or belong to another review
originHrtimeNs: Decimal string from root same-host process.hrtime.bigint() before the single launch; no renewal on resume. Excludes no later setup/cleanup/finalization time. An old/future origin is refused.
rootReceiptRawSha256: Separately supplied CLI --expect-root; not inferred from the receipt itself
mode: regular file, <=65536 bytes, exact real path
